parent_objective: make the old-key neighborhood gate replayable for arbitrary future candidate checkpoints

public_gates: implement or formalize replayable candidate evaluation for M341 compact old-key rows
reproduce M335 alpha pass and M335 repaired endpoint failure or repair-needed classification
add focused tests for replayable schema and threshold aggregation
do not run PPO or promote a checkpoint
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim M343 static saved columns certify future checkpoints
do not lower old-key neighborhood thresholds
do not train or repair a checkpoint
hypothesis: A replayable adapter can convert the M341 old-key neighborhood surface into a candidate-level proof gate so future PPO proposals can be checked without returning to singleton 9944 veto dominance.
success_criteria: future-candidate gate schema is implemented or concretely formalized
M335 alpha is reproduced as pass under replayable candidate metrics
M335 repaired endpoint is reproduced as fail or repair-needed
tests cover schema validation and pass/fail threshold aggregation
failure_criteria: adapter only reads saved selected/endpoint columns and cannot evaluate future candidates
adapter runs PPO or promotes a checkpoint

commands.name: m345_adapter
commands.command: Implement and test replayable old-key neighborhood candidate gate; no PPO.

decision_rule: M345 may only build or formalize the replayable old-key neighborhood candidate gate and admit the next no-PPO probe or PPO-design milestone. It cannot promote and cannot run PPO.
next_blocker: pending M345 old-key neighborhood replay gate adapter
